thread:
alex: :rotating_light: Detecting full control-plane silence in sea2 — cluster API returning 503/connection reset for all nodes. Auto-alert at 19:42 UTC. Kicking off triage.

maria: :eyes: On it. Running quick health checks against kube-apiserver and controllers. Paging infra oncall.

status-bot: cluster-health sea2: API endpoints unreachable from monitoring probes (5m), control-plane pod flapping observed, node heartbeats delayed.

alex: Paste of recent api-server logs:
```
E0318 19:41:55.123 kube-apiserver: apiserver: failed to listen on 6443: read tcp 10.8.0.12:6443: connection reset by peer
E0318 19:41:57.456 kube-controller-manager: failed to sync: etcd unavailable
```

sam: Possible network-level isolation between control-plane subnet and master VMs. I'm checking BGP/route tables and firewall rules now. If that's bad we should shift traffic to other regions.

maria: Confirmed control-plane health endpoints are not responding from our management plane (can't curl 6443 from ops runbooks). Attempting to ssh to control-plane node to see systemd logs.

loadbalancer-bot: Global LB: sea2 backend group health -> UNHEALTHY (all backends failing healthcheck). Failover policies available: immediate-routing / gradual-shift.

alex: Plan A: immediate shift of inference traffic to us-west2 (capacity available) using global LB emergency map. Plan B: if us-west2 capacity saturates, fallback to eu-west1 with soft rate-limits. Need hands on infra/ops to execute.

sam: Running capacity check: us-west2 GPU pool has ~120 free vGPU slots, current 90% burstable allowed. If we shift 100% we'll oversubscribe within 3 minutes unless we scale autoscaler up.

maria: Executing emergency failover steps:
```
# emergency failover to us-west2
./runbooks/lb/failover.sh --from sea2 --to us-west2 --mode immediate
kubectl --context=ops-us-west2 scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=60
```

alex: @sam please pre-warm nodes in us-west2 and bump autoscaler min to avoid cold-start spike. Also create an allocated reservation for high-priority inference traffic.

sam: Pre-warm started (provisioning extra nodes). Autoscaler min increased, scaling policy set to prefer reserved pool.

joy: I'll draft status page message + DM top customers on the enterprise list. Suggested short note: "We're experiencing a service disruption impacting the sea2 region. Traffic is being redirected; some requests may be slower. We'll share updates every 15 minutes."

maria: After ssh: control-plane hosts show NIC flaps and repeated kernel logs: "link down/up" across all masters. No obvious kernel ooms. I'm tagging networking.

sam: Networking team, can you confirm any announced cloud provider maintenance in SEA2? I don't see scheduled maint. Also cross-check our BGP sessions to the region edge.

loadbalancer-bot: Failover command executed by maria at 19:47 UTC. Global LB now routing ~85% to us-west2, 15% to eu-west1 as soft-fallback. Healthchecks ongoing.

alex: Monitoring token-level errors: token error rate spiked x10 during failover, tailing logs to ensure no request loss. If error rate stays >5% we hold traffic at 70% and notify product.

status-bot: Incident declared: Sev2. Incident document created INC-2026-045 (link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-045). Triage channel #incidents.

joy: Status page posted and sent to customers. :white_check_mark: I'll coordinate PSRs for enterprise customers.

maria: Next steps: 1) network trace with cloud provider, 2) restore control-plane NICs or rebuild master group, 3) validate etcd integrity, 4) lift failover slowly once sea2 healthy.

alex: Agreed. Assigning action owners: networking -> sam, control-plane repair -> maria, capacity & LB -> sam, comms -> joy. Keep updates short, 1–2 lines.

sam: Provider confirms an upstream network flap affecting the region edge peering; they are rolling a fix. ETA initial 10–15m.

maria: Kube-apiserver and etcd both currently read-only/unavailable; do not attempt rolling restarts until provider confirms network stable or we risk split-brain.

alex: Good catch. We'll keep sea2 drained. If provider ETA slips beyond 30m we escalate to exec and consider cross-region redistribution of reserved capacity.

sam: Noted. Monitoring scaling and error budgets. Will post when us-west2 saturates or if provider updates.

joy: Will update status page in 15 minutes or earlier if major changes.

incident-bot: Update logged: 19:58 UTC — provider reports partial restoration of peering; continue monitoring.

alex: Thanks everyone. Standby for updates. :rocket:
